text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've come to the training track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I feel great! The next race will
spell a
mighty victory for Teio for sure!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's not even race day, yet you
already feel
victorious? Curious.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Prez! You know it! I won't settle for
anything
less than total domination!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, my dream is to be the number
one
Umamusume that everyone cheers
for...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Which means there's no way I can afford
to lose
now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A courageous venture. Your warrior's
spirit is a
powerful weapon. I'm sure you
will do splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Glad to have your seal of
approval!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, do not forget about
the
concert. It is important you show
your gratitude
to your fans and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! The concert! I totally forgot
about it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll be doing my famous Teio Step center
stage!
You better be in the audience!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No one will be able to keep their eyes
off me
dancing in my signature racewear!
I can't wait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I've gotta keep practicin'! See ya
later, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get a chance to tell her not to
get ahead
of herself and slack off on her
lessons...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. She won't stay calm for even
a second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems both flustered yet

impressed by Tokai Teio's impulsiveness.
